title: Budd Johnson in Quincy Jones's band in Europe
summary: Years later Johnson toured Europe in Quincy Jones's band accompanying Nat Cole's show.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Budd Johnson. We toured together again in Europe in later years. He was with Quincy's band, Quincy Jones' band. And Bud was very unhappy, he hadn't been home for quite a while. And actually Quincy stayed over there about two years. But that was a great band. They played for us, Nat Cole, and speaking of an all star band, Jerome Richardson, Shahab, Bud Johnson, Phil Woods, Lennie Johnson, it was just an exciting exciting band. It was a thrill to have them to travel with us.
